title: Job: Split the Chai Bill
story: Job brief from four friends: we owe ₹100 for chai and cannot pay in coins. Split it so everyone pays whole rupees and the total is exact.
goal: Write split(total, n) returning a list of n whole-rupee shares that add up to total. If it does not divide evenly, the first people pay one rupee extra.
hints: divmod(total, n) gives the whole share and the leftover in one go.
The leftover rupees go one each to the first few people.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Job: Split the Chai Bill”?
